telemetry.interpretation: Command-to-visible is command receipt to first drawn generated boundary pose, not measured recognition of the requested action. Ready includes polling; it is not pure inference duration.
telemetry.cadence_assessment: Observed3 RAF gaps over100ms, max432.7ms; not stall-free. No generation-buffer hold recorded. RAF statistics describe main-loop cadence, not capture-frame delivery or a per-frame proof.
telemetry.duration_interpretation: 63.751s video contains51.4s of saved20fps motion plus wall-clock overhead and endpoint hold. It must not be described as63.751s of unique generated motion.
telemetry.timing_assessment: Typical command receipt to first drawn appended frame is about3.0s; queued bow is4.682s including1.614s queue. This measures first generated pose visibility, not semantic action onset.

metadata_caveat: This new recording has explicit current request seeds, requestIDs and framecounts; per-seam metadata is checked separately. It uses disclosed clearance-only fitted boot correction while preserving native source arrays.
